name: Create: Bitterballen 1.0.4 1.20.1-forge
changelog:
# Version 1.0.4

To start this version of, the project is now maintained by ElectricSteve.

It will also be the last version published for 1.20.1 fabric/forge. New versions will only be published for the Minecraft versions Create actively supports (currently 1.21.1 neoforge).

## Changelog

- fix: diddy dupe
- tags suggested by @Mickeon
- fix: blockstate definition errors
- unify convention tags and compat recipes; originally suggested by .neptune2004
- bump version + change archive name
- fix mods.toml (x2)

name: Create: Bitterballen-1.20.1-1.0
changelog:
**Mechanical Fryer**
- Fixed Mechanical Fryer unable to handle multiple recipes using the same input item.
- Fixed item rendering clipping in the Mechanical Fryer’s basket.
- Fixed top texture of the Mechanical Fryer missing the pole hole.
- Fixed partial rendering on the mechanical fryer not rotating with the block.
- Fixed Mechanical Fryer not discriminating between super heated and heated conditions.
- Added minor optimisations in Mechanical Fryer model.
- Added the ability to place blocks on the Mechanical Fryer without shift-clicking if the block
is not part of a valid recipe.
- Added compatibility with all custom burner blocks using the
“BlazeBurnerBlock.HEAT_LEVEL” property.
- Reworked Mechanical Fryer to match Create's new copper palette.


**Effects**
- Fixed non-player entities not receiving the Oiled Up effect when in Frying Oil.
- Fixed non-player entities not experiencing the effects of the Oiled Up effect.
- Added sliding to Oiled Up effect.
- Added Oiled Up effect I now only gives the sliding effect.
- Added Oiled Up effect II now gives the effects from the level below + randomly dropping
items + floating in water/rain + falling off ladders.
- Added Oiled up effect III or higher now gives the effects from the level below + deep fried
visual and audio effects (only accessible through commands due to a rendering bug).
- Added entities now hit by (coated) oliebollen with the potato cannon will receive 10
seconds of the Oiled Up effect.
- Reworked Oiled Up effect duration from 20 seconds to 60 seconds for the frying oil bottle.
- Reworked swimming in Frying Oil now gives Oiled Up II.


**Sunflowers**
- Fixed Sunflower top age not matching up with bottom age.
- Fixed harvesters breaking sunflowers.
- Fixed Sunflowers loot table overwriting all other Sunflower loot tables.
- Added proper Sunflower textures for different growth stages.
- Added Sunflower Seeds as breeding items for chickens.
- Added compatibility with the Growth Accelerator from AE2.
- Reworked vanilla Sunflowers hitbox to follow the model, instead of being a full block.


**Other Fixes**
- Fixed typo in Stamppot advancement ID.
- Fixed improper meat properties on Wrapped (Chocolate Glazed) Stroopwafels.
- Fixed Stamppot Bowl ability to stack .


**Other Additions**
- Added tooltip to Cheese to explain aging.
- Added tooltip to Wrapped items to explain the benefits of wrapping.
- Added Herring mob, can spawn in (cold) oceans.
- Added Sugar Coated Oilebollen.
- Added 4 new advancements.


**Other Reworks**
- Reworked Raw Churros recipe from 2x Flour, Water and Sugar to 1x Dough and Sugar.
- Reworked advancement ordering.
- Reworked Doughlightful advancement, now requires obtaining oliebollen instead of
consuming them.
- Reworked Wrapped items, to be consumed in 20 ticks instead of 25 ticks.


**Food Rebalancing**

Kruidnoten
- Food points increased from 3 to 4.


Speculaas
- Food points increased from 5 to 8.
- Saturation reduced from 0.3 to 0.2.


Stroopwafel
- Food points increased from 7 to 9.


Wrapped Stroopwafel
- Food points increased from 7 to 9.


Chocolate Glazed Stroopwafel
- Food points increased from 9 to 11.


Wrapped Chocolate Glazed Stroopwafel
- Food points increased from 9 to 11.


Oliebollen
- Food points increased from 5 to 8.
- Saturation increased from 0.2 to 0.3.


Cheese Souffle
- Food points increased from 8 to 11.


Kroket
- Food points increased from 8 to 11.
- Saturation increased from 0.2 to 0.4.


Kroket Sandwich
- Food points increased from 10 to 13.
- Saturation increased from 0.3 to 0.4.


Ketchup / Mayo Kroket Sandwich
- Food points increased from 10 to 13.
- Saturation increased from 0.3 to 0.5.


Ketchup & Mayo Kroket Sandwich
- Food points increased from 10 to 14.
- Saturation increased from 0.3 to 0.5.


Bitterballen
- Food points increased from 7 to 10.
- Saturation increased from 0.2 to 0.4.


Eggball
- Food points increased from 3 to 6.


Frikandel
- Food points increased from 8 to 11.
- Saturation increased from 0.2 to 0.4.


Frikandel Sandwich
- Food points increased from 10 to 13.
- Saturation increased from 0.3 to 0.4.


Ketchup / Mayo Frikandel Sandwich
- Food points increased from 10 to 13.
- Saturation increased from 0.3 to 0.5.


Ketchup & Mayo Frikandel Sandwich
- Food points increased from 10 to 14.
- Saturation increased from 0.3 to 0.5.


Wrapped Ketchup / Mayo Fries
- Saturation increased from 0.5 to 0.6.


Wrapped Ketchup & Mayo Fries
- Food points increased from 6 to 7.
- Saturation increased from 0.5 to 0.6.


Churros
- Food points increased from 5 to 6.


Wrapped Churros
- Food points increased from 5 to 6.


Coated Churros
- Food points increased from 7 to 10.


Wrapped Coated Churros
- Food points increased from 7 to 10.


Stamppot Bowl
- Food points increased from 10 to 15.
